auth.heading: Sign in to the management console

twoFactor.codeHeading: Enter the code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.codeInstructions: Open the authenticator app for this account and type the six-digit code it shows right now.
twoFactor.codeStepAnnouncement: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.enrolInstructions: This is your first time signing in: scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy or similar). If you can't scan it, type the secret key by hand instead.
twoFactor.enrolQrAlt: QR code to set up the second factor in your authenticator app
twoFactor.enrolQrUnavailable: The QR code could not be generated. Use the secret key below to set up your authenticator app.
twoFactor.enrolStepAnnouncement: Set up your second factor before you can sign in.

errors.retryAfter: You can try again in {seconds} s.

network.title: The server could not be reached
network.advice: Check the network connection and try again. If the console still does not answer, tell whoever administers this installation: nothing you did has been saved.

unauthenticated.title: Your session has expired
unauthenticated.advice: Sign in again to carry on. Management sessions are deliberately short.

invalidCredentials.title: The email address or the password is not correct
invalidCredentials.advice: Check them and try again. After several failed attempts the account is locked for a few minutes, even if you then type the right password.

forbidden.title: You are not allowed to do this
forbidden.advice: Your role does not reach this data. If you think it should, ask whoever administers this installation.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.advice: It may no longer exist, or it may fall outside your scope. Go back to the list and refresh.

conflict.title: This does not match the current state
conflict.advice: Someone may have changed it before you, or the action was already done. Refresh the screen and check how things stand before repeating it.

validation.title: Some data needs checking
validation.advice: Fix the fields listed below and submit the form again.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests in a row
rateLimited.advice: Wait a few seconds and try again.

unavailable.title: This installation cannot handle the operation
unavailable.advice: Server configuration is missing. Tell whoever administers this installation: it is not a problem with what you typed.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.advice: Try again. If it happens again, tell whoever administers this installation, with the exact time and what you were doing.

forbidden.heading: No access to this section
forbidden.description: Your account does not hold the scope this screen needs. It is not a fault: the server would refuse it anyway.

notFound.heading: This page does not exist
notFound.description: The address does not match any section of the console.

employees.title: Workforce
employees.subtitle: Hiring, records and offboarding. Nothing is deleted: offboarding keeps the record and its time entries.

empty.title: There is nobody to show
empty.description: No one has been added to this installation yet.
empty.filtered: Nobody matches the filters you chose. Try clearing them.

table.caption: Workforce of this installation, with employment status and PIN state.
table.name: Name

fields.departmentHint: Optional. The person belongs to this installation's site.
fields.emailHint: Optional. No feature of this product requires it: the portal is opened with an employee code and a PIN.
fields.nationalIdHint: Optional. It is not stored: the server keeps only a digest of it, so the same person is not added twice.

create.heading: Add an employee
create.pinNotice: The employee code is generated by the server. Completing this form issues the portal PIN and shows it once only: be ready to write it down or hand it over right then.

detail.statusHint: Offboarding does not happen here: it has its own section because it carries a termination date and consequences.
detail.confirmHeading: Confirm the changes to this record
detail.confirmExplanation: This is what will change. Check the starting value before you confirm: who changed it and when will be recorded.

credentialEmpty.title: No credential row yet
credentialEmpty.description: This person does not have a row in the credentials board yet. Try again in a few minutes.

credentialInactive.title: The card is not managed from this record
credentialInactive.description: This person is not currently on staff, so the credentials board does not assign a row here. Their card is managed from the credentials board.

offboard.heading: Offboarding
offboard.explanation: Offboarding is logical, never a deletion: the record, its shift entries and its work days are kept for four years, because an inspection can ask for the records of someone who no longer works here.
offboard.alreadyTerminated: This person has been offboarded since {date}. Their history is still available.
offboard.dateHint: Never earlier than the hire date. Record retention starts counting from it.
offboard.reasonHint: It goes into the audit log. No health data and no value judgements.
offboard.consequenceCredential: Their QR card is revoked and stops working at the kiosk.
offboard.consequenceScan: From the termination date on, they cannot clock in.
offboard.consequenceHistory: Nothing is deleted: their time records are kept and can still be consulted.

pin.heading: Employee portal PIN
pin.explanation: With their employee code and this PIN, the person checks their own time records in the portal. It is handed over in person, never by email.

statusHint.pending: This person has no PIN and cannot open the portal. Reset it to issue one.
statusHint.issued: The PIN exists but has not been recorded as handed over.
statusHint.delivered: It was handed over in person, with the date and the responsible person in the audit log.

reset.heading: Reset the PIN
reset.explanation: A new six-digit PIN is generated and the previous one stops working immediately. The failed-attempt lockout is cleared as well.
reset.warning: The new PIN will be shown once, now. It cannot be looked up again: if it is lost, it has to be reset once more.

delivery.heading: Record the PIN handover
delivery.explanation: It will be recorded that {name} received their PIN in person, with the date and you as the responsible person.
delivery.auditNotice: It goes into the audit log and cannot be repeated or undone. Tick it only once the handover has actually happened.

reveal.heading: PIN issued
reveal.onlyOnce: This PIN is shown once and cannot be looked up again. Write it down or hand it over right now. If it is lost, the only way out is to reset it.
reveal.handDelivery: Handover is in person. This product never sends a PIN by email or through any link.
reveal.handedOverLabel: I confirm that I have handed this PIN to {name} in person.
reveal.acknowledge: I have written it down, I will hand it over later

announce.reset: PIN reset. It is shown once only.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.subtitle: Who can clock in with their card and who cannot yet. A card only works once it is printed and handed over.

filters.pendingOnly: Only people who do not hold their card yet

summary.heading: Workforce of this installation
summary.withoutDelivered: Without their card in hand: {missing} of {total}.

rotation.heading: Signing key rotation in progress
rotation.explanation: Key {keyId}, which signs the old cards, is being replaced. While the handover lasts the old cards still clock in and out, so nobody is left out. Each old card is retired automatically as soon as its replacement is handed over.
rotation.complete: Nobody clocks in with key {keyId} any more: it can be retired on the server.

unknownKey.heading: Some cards no longer work for clocking in
unknownKey.explanation: {count} card(s) in circulation are signed with a key the server no longer recognises. Anyone carrying one of them cannot clock in with their card: they will have to use their PIN until it is fixed.
unknownKey.action: This is fixed by whoever administers the server: run «php artisan credentials:status» to find out which key it is and follow docs/runbooks/rotacion-clave-qr.md §6.

empty.title: There are no rows to show
empty.description: Nobody is active within the chosen scope.
empty.allDelivered: Everyone within the chosen scope already holds their card.
empty.filtered: Nobody matches the filters you chose. Try clearing them.

table.caption: Card status per person. Times are shown in the site's time zone.

issue.heading: Issue a credential
issue.explanation: A credential will be issued for {name}. It starts out waiting to be printed and cannot clock in yet.
issue.notice: The QR is not generated yet: it is minted when the card is printed.

print.heading: Print the card
print.explanation: The PDF of the card for {name} will be generated and downloaded to this computer.
print.notice: Printing mints the QR and there is no way back: reprinting does not exist. If the PDF is lost, the only way out is to revoke the credential and issue another. Print it only with the printer ready.

deliver.heading: Record the card handover
deliver.explanation: It will be recorded that {name} received their card, with the date and you as the responsible person.
deliver.notice: It goes into the audit log and cannot be repeated or undone. It is what tells «the card was lost before we gave it to them» apart from «the employee lost it».

revoke.heading: Revoke the credential
revoke.explanation: The card belonging to {name} will stop working at the kiosk from now on.
revoke.notice: Nothing is deleted: the credential keeps its history and its scans. Replacing the card means issuing a new one and printing it, which are two further acts.

reasons.printFailed: Failed printing: the PDF never came out

batch.heading: Print the batch of pending cards
batch.explanation: All credentials waiting to be printed in this installation will be laid out on a single A4 sheet. There are {count} right now.
batch.warning: Their QR codes are all minted now and there is no reprinting. If the PDF is lost, every card has to be revoked and issued again.
batch.bearerNotice: The PDF is a bearer document: whoever holds it can make somebody else's card. It is not stored on the server and it is never emailed.

announce.issued: Credential issued for {name}. It is waiting to be printed.
announce.printed: Card for {name} generated. They can clock in once they receive it.
announce.batchEmpty: There was no card waiting to be printed within the chosen scope.

corrections.title: Time record corrections
corrections.notice: Nothing is deleted or overwritten: the previous version is kept with your name, the date and the reason, and stays available.
corrections.supersededNotice: This entry is no longer the current version: somebody corrected or voided it before you. Reload the work day and check how it stands now.
corrections.wouldChangeWorkDate: That clock-in time would move the work day to another date. To move hours from one day to another, void the entry here and create it on the right day: two actions, each with its own reason.
corrections.reasonHint: It stays in the legal record and a labour inspection can read it. No health data, no value judgements.
corrections.reasonOtherHint: At least 20 characters. "Error" or "adjustment" explain nothing to an inspection.

reasonHints.OLVIDO_FICHAJE_ENTRADA: The person started work and did not clock in.
reasonHints.OLVIDO_FICHAJE_SALIDA: The person finished and did not clock out: the entry was left open.
reasonHints.FALLO_TECNICO_QUIOSCO: The kiosk was not working: no power, no camera, or no network beyond the offline queue.
reasonHints.TARJETA_NO_DISPONIBLE: The card was left in the locker, lost, or is damaged.
reasonHints.CREDENCIAL_NO_ENTREGADA: Their card had not been handed over yet.
reasonHints.ERROR_DE_ESCANEO_DUPLICADO: Two scans produced two entries where there was only one.
reasonHints.AJUSTE_ACORDADO_CON_RRHH: Correction agreed with the person and with HR, not a system error.
reasonHints.ALTA_RETROACTIVA: Work day before the system went live or before the person was registered.
reasonHints.OTROS: None of the above. It must be explained in writing.

legalExport.heading: Export for the Labour Inspectorate
legalExport.intro: Generates the daily working time record per worker and period that is handed over on a Labour Inspectorate request (article 34.9 of the Spanish Workers' Statute). The file downloads as CSV and is not kept in the browser.
legalExport.workDateHint: First day of the period, by work date: a shift that started on the 31st at 22:00 belongs to the 31st even if it ended on the 1st.
legalExport.inclusiveHint: Last day of the period, included.
legalExport.inverted: The period ends before it starts. Check both dates: they are not swapped for you.
legalExport.employeeHint: Worker identifier if the request names one person. Left blank, the whole workforce is exported.
legalExport.done: Export downloaded: {shiftEntries} shift entries and {corrections} corrections.
legalExport.failed: The export could not be generated.
legalExport.audited: Every generation is recorded in the audit trail with who exported, which period and which scope. The audit trail never stores worker names.
legalExport.noSiteFilter: The export is not filtered by site or department: every row states its site, and the scope can only be the whole workforce or one person.

contents.heading: What the file contains
contents.entries: One row per period of work, with clock in, clock out, duration and daily total. A night shift is a single entry, on the day it started.
contents.corrections: One row per amendment to the record, with its author, its moment and its reason.
contents.voided: Voided entries are included, with their status, and do not add hours to the daily total. Nothing is hidden.
contents.times: Times are given in the time zone of the site and also in UTC, which is how they are stored.
contents.format: CSV in UTF-8 with byte order mark, semicolon separated. Durations are written HH:MM, never as a decimal.

period.title: Hours by period
period.subtitle: Hours worked over a period, with department or site aggregates and the comparison against contracted hours. The criteria used to calculate it are shown below the table.
period.contractCoverage: There are {days} person-days in this period with no contract on record, affecting {employees} person(s). Those days add no contracted hours: the deviation on those rows is incomplete.

workdays.title: Time record
workdays.subtitle: Day by day, with every period of work, its total and every amendment it has had. Nothing is deleted: what was corrected is still here, with who did it and why.
workdays.fromEmployee: The hours recorded for this person, day by day, with the amendment history of each day. Reading it changes nothing in the record.
workdays.zoneNotice: Times are shown in the time zone of the site where the person clocked in, not in the one of the computer you are looking from.
workdays.auditNotice: Reading someone else's time record is written to the audit log, with who looked, at whom and for what period.

filters.fromHint: By work date: a shift that started at 22:00 belongs to the day it started, even though it ended the next day.
filters.toHint: Last day, included. Left blank, the last 31 days are queried according to the site's calendar.
filters.inverted: The period ends before it starts. Check both dates: they do not swap themselves.
filters.tooWide: The period cannot exceed {days} days. Query the history in shorter stretches.
filters.resolved: Work days from {from} to {to}, in {zone} time.

empty.title: No work days recorded in this period
empty.description: This is not a failed query: on those days this person has no clockings at all. Try another period or check whether they were employed.

day.recalculatedNever: This day has no recalculated total yet: the one shown is the sum of its entries.

flags.openShiftHint: A shift is still open: the total for this day will still go up and cannot be used for payroll until it is closed.
flags.incidentHint: An entry was flagged as anomalous. It is not a system error: it means someone has to look at it.

entries.caption: Periods of work on {date}, in the {zone} time zone
entries.notRecorded: No reception mark: this time was written by a person, not by a scan.
entries.queued: It arrived from the kiosk queue, {delay} after the clocking. What counts for the record is the time of the clocking.
entries.empty: This day has no current periods of work. If there are amendments below, they were voided: the history is still complete.
entries.mismatch: The recorded daily total does not match the sum of its entries. Both are shown and neither is chosen: tell whoever administers the system before using these hours for payroll.

history.heading: Amendment history
history.notice: Each amendment created a new version and kept the previous one. What you see here is what the record said before and what it says now.
history.empty: This day has not been amended: the entries are the ones recorded when clocking.
history.caption: What the amendment of {moment} changed

compliance.heading: Compliance profile
compliance.intro: The legal thresholds used to review this site's time records. They ship with the Spanish hospitality profile; adjust them to the collective agreement that applies to you.
compliance.detectionWarning: These thresholds decide which working days are flagged for review. A change applies from the moment it is saved: history is not recalculated and no already-recorded issue is closed or reopened. Note that the daily review looks back over the last 7 days, so tightening a threshold can raise issues for past working days that fall inside that window.
compliance.pendingDetectionWarning: You are about to change an incident detection threshold. From the next daily review, different working days will be flagged than are flagged today.
compliance.retentionWarning: You are about to change how many years records are kept. Lowering it widens what the purge treats as expired, over data you are legally required to keep. No purge runs on its own: the retention command proposes in simulation first and requires an explicit confirmation.
compliance.notAppliedYet: Weekly working hours, the first day of the week and the holiday calendar are stored and audited, but no rule applies them yet: the compliance view will be the first to use them.
compliance.saved: Profile saved. The change is recorded in the audit trail.
compliance.failed: The profile could not be saved.
compliance.audited: Every threshold changed leaves an audit trail entry with the previous value, the new one, who changed it and when.

source.installation: Profile “{name}” ({jurisdiction}), the installation default: this site has none assigned and inherits its changes.

fields.name: Collective agreement name
fields.breakRequiredAfterHours: Maximum continuous stretch without a break (h)

hints.name: The name of the agreement this profile describes. It appears in the retention report.
hints.minRestHours: An issue is opened if fewer hours pass between the end of one shift and the start of the next. 12 in the Spanish profile (art. 34.3 ET).
hints.maxDailyHours: An issue is opened if the sum of a day's shifts exceeds these hours. 9 in the Spanish profile.
hints.maxWeeklyHours: 40 in the Spanish profile (art. 34.1 ET). Annual averaging is set by the collective agreement.
hints.breakRequiredAfterHours: Threshold for a continuous stretch with no break recorded. 6 in the Spanish profile. It is stored and evaluated; it does not raise issues today (see the note below).
hints.weekStartsOn: Used to group by week. Monday in the Spanish profile (ISO 8601).
hints.holidayCalendar: One date per line, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Ships empty: holidays depend on the town and the year, so each installation loads its own.
hints.retentionYears: Four years in Spain (art. 34.9 ET). Nothing can be purged before that.

compliance.breakSuspended: The continuous stretch without a break is evaluated, but it does not raise issues yet: until the kiosk records the break as such, the system cannot tell "did not rest" from "rested and did not clock it". The threshold is stored and will apply once detection is switched back on.

errors.notAWholeNumber: Enter a whole number, with no decimals or letters.
errors.required: This field cannot be left empty.

license.heading: Licence
license.intro: What was contracted, until when, how much is in use, and which accessory features are available.
license.neverDegraded: Clocking in and out, work day lookups, the employee portal, the labour inspection export, corrections, the audit trail and backups do NOT depend on the licence: they work the same whatever its state. What is governed here are the accessory features.
license.excessNote: Exceeding a plan figure has not prevented any hiring or any pairing, and it will not. It is recorded in the audit trail with the exact date; talk to your provider whenever it suits you to extend the plan.

hints.signedKey: The string your provider gave you. It starts with "KQL1.". You can paste it with spaces or line breaks: they are cleaned up automatically.

detail.valid: Expires on {until}. We will warn you {warningDays} days in advance.
detail.expiring_soon: Expires on {until}: {days} days left. Nothing has been degraded yet. Ask your provider for the renewal and activate it here when it arrives.
detail.expired: Expired on {until}, {elapsed} days ago. Since then, the accessory features below are unavailable. The time record keeps working in full.
detail.absent: No key has been activated yet. Activate it below; your provider gives it to you. In the meantime clocking and record lookups work normally.
detail.not_yet_valid: The activated key starts on {from}. Nothing to do: the accessory features switch on by themselves that day.
detail.unverifiable: The stored key cannot be verified. The time record keeps working in full; what is unavailable are the accessory features.

rejections.malformed: The key is incomplete or truncated, which usually happens when copying it from an email. Paste the whole key again.
rejections.bad_signature: This key was not issued by the vendor of this version, or it was modified in transit. Ask your provider for a new key.
rejections.invalid_payload: The key is signed but incomplete. This is an issuing fault: tell your provider and ask for a new key.
rejections.no_public_key: This installation does not carry the vendor public key, so it cannot verify any licence. This is not a problem with your key, it is a deployment problem: tell your provider, quoting the version returned by GET /api/v1/health.

restrictions.license_expired: unavailable because the licence expired on {since}
restrictions.license_unverifiable: unavailable: the licence cannot be verified
restrictions.not_in_plan: not included in the contracted plan

notice.valid: The licence is valid. This notice is shown for another reason, stated below.
notice.expiring_soon: The licence expires on {until}, in {days} days. Nothing has been degraded yet: renew it so that period reports and real-time presence stay available.
notice.expired: The licence expired on {until}, {elapsed} days ago. Period reports and real-time presence have been degraded since then. Clocking and record access keep working normally.
notice.absent: This installation has no activated licence. Clocking and record access work normally; accessory features do not. Activate the key your provider gave you.
notice.not_yet_valid: The activated licence starts on {from}. Until then the accessory features are unavailable. Nothing else to do.
notice.unverifiable: The stored licence cannot be verified. Clocking and record access work normally; accessory features do not.
notice.exceeded: Also, the contracted plan has been exceeded in: {limits}. It blocks nothing; talk to your provider to extend it.
